tolerances.justification: MEASURED on the capture machine (per blueprint's mandatory empirical check; pairwise across repeated captures 2026-08-05): opacity_cup 4 reps, solar_earth 3 reps, flagship_glass 2 reps differ only at LSB level (worst pair: changed>4 = 0.0304%, mean|d| = 0.0101, p99 = 0, max = 18); clock_mid 3 reps and ring_sph_mid/solar_wide 3 reps bit-identical; water_shutter demoted after a Tier-1 catch (worst pair changed>4 = 0.0004%, mean 0.0005, p99 0, max 6). Gates sit >= 6x (changed_frac), ~10x (mean_abs), and inf (p99, measured 0) above the worst observed noise — still comfortably over the >=3x rule. TIGHTENED from the blueprint's a-priori defaults (0.01/2.0/12) by the R0 review 2026-08-05: an independent perturbation drill (skyEmit zenith blue 0.75->0.78) produced a REAL renderer change of mean|d| 0.12-1.20 with every |d| <= 4, which the a-priori gates missed on all eight Tier-2 entries — only the three Tier-1 exact entries caught it. Same-env noise is ~100x below these gates, so Tier-2 must gate near the noise floor to have discrimination power. Foreign-env runs (advisory by definition) may WARN more often under these gates; the banner already directs a recapture on that machine for the authoritative exact gate.

tolerances.justification: table_stack: measured its OWN noise floor with --noise --reps 5 (2026-08-06) rather than reusing the shared default -- worst pairwise on unmodified code: changed_frac=0.0017%, mean_abs=0.116, p99_abs=1 -- exceeding the shared mean_abs=0.10 gate on a scene the SVO compile gate proves is byte-identical shader text (zero Voxel leaves; not R4-related). Root cause: 48 deep CSG leaves means more silhouette edges, hence more discrete hit/miss pixel flips per render than the scenes the shared tolerance was calibrated against. Per-entry override (>=3x the measured worst pairwise, matching the shared tolerance's own stated rule) added rather than loosening the shared gate for every other (much quieter) scene.
